nodeGroups.name: Check proposal expiry
nodeGroups.description: Looks up a stored proposal by event ID and reports whether it is still valid or expired; read-only

nodeGroups.name: Check proposal can be approved
nodeGroups.description: Re-reads the stored proposal and ledger revision; only an unexpired PENDING proposal for the owner can get a token

nodeGroups.name: Issue and store token
nodeGroups.description: Creates a random token, stores only its hash plus a binding hash of the proposal details; nothing is committed

nodeGroups.name: Check command and owner
nodeGroups.description: Accepts only the exact text COMMIT plus a 16-character token from the registered owner; anything else is rejected

nodeGroups.name: Validate stored approval
nodeGroups.description: Finds the proposal by token hash and checks status, expiry, sender, ledger revision and the binding hash

nodeGroups.name: Reserve and re-check
nodeGroups.description: Consumes the token, then re-reads the proposal to confirm the reservation; this narrows but cannot remove races

nodeGroups.name: Check command and owner 1
nodeGroups.description: Accepts only CANCEL token, or EDIT token plus new text, from the registered owner

nodeGroups.name: Find and validate approval
nodeGroups.description: Finds the proposal by token hash and confirms it still has an active approval for this sender

nodeGroups.name: Invalidate approval
nodeGroups.description: Consumes the token and marks the proposal CANCELLED or SUPERSEDED, then re-reads to confirm; no ledger access
